Target Server Error

This target page fails on every attempt.

Synthetic S6-1 target fixture. Not a copy of any real page.
contract_intent: A terminal 5xx: ServerError maps to access_status server_error. Deliberately NOT a retry test — what the committed HttpClient does between the first 500 and the raise is its own tested contract, and Stage 6 neither owns nor re-asserts it.
